description: The State Environmental Service of Latvia (VVD) publishes its permit registers and waste reporting data as open data. The permits data set lists every waste management permit it has issued, split into collection, handling, sorting, storage and transport, together with category A, B and C environmental permits, combustion plants and other licences. A second data set comes from APUS, the national system in which every waste shipment is recorded, restructured to match the annual waste report form: part A lists reporting organisations and sites with registration numbers, address codes and whether they produce or manage waste, and parts B and C give the waste generated and managed. Coverage is national. All five VVD data sets are free and available to download as CSV under CC0, updated continuously, with the APUS files served through an API. Caveats: APUS figures are current at the time of access and change as reports are filed, sites are identified by address and cadastral codes, not coordinates, and documentation is in Latvian. Simulation uses: mapping Latvia's licensed waste collection and treatment operators, building waste flow networks from APUS transfers, and planning treatment capacity. Related records: the England waste operations permit register (data-ea-waste-operations-permit-register) is a comparable register, and Eurostat municipal waste (data-eurostat-env-wasmun) gives national totals.
